findings: A terse « mutatis mutandis » (AUDIT-1 minor): the proof of prop:isom at l.459 says « Δ is timelike, so g is elliptic », which fails at α = 0 where Δ = R(1,1,0) is lightlike; the paper supplies the α = 0 pieces itself (the h_ℓ in isom(E₀∞), l.437, non-injective for ℓ ≠ 1, l.369–370), and orientation reversal is excluded for g in Isom₀. The formal proof adds λ = 1 from one turn of the holonomy (GX.E0AbsMax.e0Loop_lam_eq_one). The statement is true at α = β = 0.
questions: 'a.e. E-morphism phi : U -> E_beta' for an open U of E_alpha (l.378-381) needs a singular structure on U. Reading taken: the induced structure, i.e. the pullback along the inclusion (GX.opensSingularGXStructure, the unique maximal a.e. atlas making the inclusion an a.e. morphism).

labels.label: btzcor:indeed_group_isometries

hypotheses.note: the homeomorphisms Psi of E0 such that Psi and Psi^-1 are a.e. (Isom_0(M3), M3)-morphisms

findings: Imprecise wording, not an error (AUDIT-1 minor): « isometries of E_α » (l.385–386) is meant, in the paper's frame (l.203 Isom₀; l.266–270 oriented and time-oriented; l.375), as orientation- and time-orientation-preserving isometries, for which the corollary holds (btzcor_indeed_group_isometries_e0). Read as isometries of the metric ds₀² it would include the reflection (τ, r, θ) ↦ (τ, r, −θ), which preserves ds₀² (btzPaperDev_refl) and is not in isom(E₀) (reflE0_ne_isomE0); a wording such as « orientation- and time-orientation-preserving isometries » would be exact.
questions: 'group of isometries of E_alpha': the reading taken is the automorphism group of the singular Isom_0-structure. The metric reading is refuted at alpha = 0 (see findings); the author decides which one the corollary means.

labels.label: btzcor:morphism_two_manifolds_local

hypotheses.note: M, N are any singular (Isom(M3), M3)-manifolds. At singular points the conclusion is stated in E_0-charts, so singular points of type alpha > 0 are not covered.

a local isomorphism of the E_0-atlases. On Reg M, phi is an M3-morphism into Reg N; phi^-1(Sing N) = Sing M; in any two E_0-charts at a singular x and at phi x (homeomorphisms kappa : U ~ V, V open in E_0, which are a.e. morphisms, cf. l.271), phi is near x the restriction of an element of isom(E_0).

questions: 'local diffeomorphism' (l.393): the paper builds no smooth structure here; its smoothness is btzcor:manifold_smooth_manifold_singular, which is not in scope. Reading taken, as the roadmap evidence (ii) suggests: phi reads, in the E_0-atlas, as elements of the model groupoid, i.e. Isom(M3) near regular points and isom(E_0) near singular points. The E_0-charts at a singular point are taken as a.e.-morphism homeomorphisms onto open subsets of E_0, reading 'a neighbourhood which embeds by an a.e. E-morphism into E_alpha' (l.271).

kb_proposals: e0Groupoid contains no reflection: GX.BTZIsom.not_conj_localForm. An element of G that reads near an axis point as (tau, z) -> (tau + a, w conj z) is impossible, by the determinant of Isom(M3) = SO_0(1,2) x| R^3. So the R of GX.E0AbsMax.e0Loop_localForm is always a rotation (use linear_isometry_complex, then not_conj_localForm). Rigid.lean:73's 'k = -1 not excluded' concerns the winding in that proof, not G.

isom(E0) as a.e. morphisms and in G: GX.BTZIsom.isomE0 tau0 theta0 (through toPaper), isAEMorphism_isomE0, e0Lift_isomE0_mem. In sector charts: chartMap (Psi y) (Psi w) = gShift tau0 c . chartMap y w on all of E0 (chartMap_paperIsom), with gShift = translation(2 tau0 u) * btzHol 0 (-c).

From the SingularGX framework to e0Groupoid: for phi : U -> BTZE0 (U : Opens BTZE0, induced structure) an a.e. morphism and a local homeomorphism, GX.BTZIsom.exists_mem_e0Groupoid_liftY gives, at each regular point of U, an e in e0Groupoid with EqOn (liftY U phi) e e.source. That is what e0_localUnique_sing's hf needs.

GX.BTZIsom.mem_e0Groupoid_of_charts: an OpenPartialHomeomorph of E0Y that is a local Isom(M3)-translation between e0Atlas charts at each point of its source is in e0Groupoid. The symm half and regularity come for free.
GX.BTZIsom.isRegularOn_reg_of_isLocalHomeomorph: an a.e. morphism that is a local homeomorphism is IsRegularOn on all of Reg M (lem:GX_sing_homeo_reg plus isRegularOn_regLocusOf), in one line.
